messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Has Directive 2006/42/EC not yet been repealed as of 18 January 2027, meaning it is still in force on that date?

response.text: La direttiva 2006/42/CE non è ancora stata abrogata alla data del 18 gennaio 2027, quindi è ancora in vigore a quella data?
